trust_decision.summary: Runtime values (LINQ dictionary keys, projected constants, tenant ids) are treated as data by Marten's SQL generation only if each emitter quotes/escapes or binds them; at the pinned commit several emitters inline them raw into single-quoted SQL literals.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'LINQ provider ... unescaped string literals'; the dictionary indexer key interpolated into ->> '{key}' is the most obvious LINQ literal built from a runtime value.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Tenant-side sites are not 'the LINQ provider', and code comments claim tenant ids are already validated by AssertValidPostgresqlIdentifiers (src/Marten/Events/Daemon/Internals/EventLoader.cs:141-144) — but that check only validates partition suffixes, not tenant ids (src/Marten/AdvancedOperations.cs:544, src/Marten/AdvancedOperations.cs:626-628).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The daemon tenant predicate must stay an inline literal (not a bound parameter) so Postgres partition-prunes mt_events at plan time; fix must escape, not parameterize. Legit keys/labels containing quotes (e.g. O'Brien) must round-trip, and numeric HAVING constants (g.Count() > 1) must keep working.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GroupBy HAVING resolver inlines comparison constants via ToString() with no quoting at all (g.Key == capturedString)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: HAVING is an aggregate/numeric feature; string-key comparisons arguably 'never supported' (a plain string literal yields invalid SQL), so it looks like an unsupported combination rather than the reported literal-escaping bug
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different file and parser (Linq/Parsing/GroupBySelectParser.cs, wired from src/Marten/Linq/CollectionUsage.Compilation.cs:706-710); appended raw at src/Marten/Linq/Parsing/GroupBySelectParser.cs:459-463

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Same HAVING resolver, captured-local branch (TryToParseConstant) also inlines raw ToString()
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: same as above; looks like a fallback for evaluated numeric locals

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Select projection non-string constant branch emits raw.ToString() unquoted (e.g. char or captured object whose ToString carries text)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: intended for numbers/bools; published fix only touched the string branch two lines above

O8b_injection_room.sibling: base constructor builds JSONBLocator from the raw (unescaped) dictionary key before DictionaryItemMember overrides only RawLocator/TypedLocator; a consumer of JSONBLocator on a dictionary item would re-open the hole
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: a maintainer adding e.g. IsSupersetOf/containment support for dictionary items would naturally use member.JSONBLocator (as src/Marten/Linq/Parsing/Methods/IsSupersetOf.cs:28 does) — a how-type producer the fix never touched

O8b_injection_room.sibling: key text inside the '{a, b, key}' text-array path literal: escaping ' is fixed but path-array grammar (comma/brace/quote in key, enum branch unserialized) is a separator-split differential on the key's identity
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: path segments are joined by ', ' with no array-element quoting; a maintainer extending ContainsKey to nested dictionaries would add segments the same way

O8b_injection_room.sibling: flattened-table projection writes a configured value as '{_value}' literal
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: same quoting idiom; a variant fed by event data instead of configuration would be a natural feature addition

O8b_injection_room.sibling: planted copy of the ngram-rank literal without the existing Replace("'", "''")
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the fix comments cite this as the escaping precedent; a second ranking operator copied from an older version would lack it

O9_family: SQL injection (CWE-89) via runtime values interpolated into single-quoted SQL/DDL literals in a query builder
